about.title: Oshrat Aharon
text: I'm a hairstylist specialising in bridal and evening hair. Most of my weeks begin on a wedding morning, in a bride's home or a suite, with coffee, a mirror and a box of pins.
I want you to feel calm and looked after, from your first message until you walk to the chuppah. I love working alongside the makeup artist, at your pace and with plenty of patience.

process.title: From first message to the chuppah

steps.x: Through the form or on WhatsApp: the date, the getting-ready city and how many people need styling.
I reply Sunday to Thursday, with a quote.
We meet before the wedding and choose your style together.
I come to where you're getting ready, style your hair, place the veil and stay until everything is right.

masterclass.title: Private masterclass
masterclass.text: One-to-one training for hairstylists who want to work with brides: building an updo that holds, waves that don't drop, and a calm, organised wedding morning.

program.x: Base, volume and products that hold through the whole event.
Low, soft or high, step by step.
Soft or Hollywood waves, and the technique that keeps them.
Where and how to secure a veil, a tiara or pins without ruining the style.
Timing, working with the bridal party, and photographing your work.

masterclass.soonText: Leave your details and we'll pick a date that suits you.

items.x: A hydrating mask once a week and a light trim a month before. Colour? Two weeks before, not the day before.
An open back loves an updo. A sweetheart or off-shoulder neckline suits waves. A long veil decides where the style sits.
Send two or three styles you love, and one you really don't. It helps me more than any explanation.
Clean, fully dry hair, no oils or creams. A button-up shirt, so nothing goes over your head.
Your veil, accessories, any pins you were given, and a table near a window.
Leave yourself room. We'll set the morning order together: who goes first, when the makeup artist and photographer arrive.

partners.title: Makeup artists I work with
partners.text: No makeup artist yet? I'm happy to recommend one.

zone.title: I come to you
zone.text: I travel to wherever you're getting ready: home, suite, hotel or venue. Tell me the city and I'll let you know what's possible on your date.
zone.cityText: I'm based in {city} and travel to other cities depending on the date.

items.q: When do you reply to messages?
items.a: Sunday to Thursday, 8:30 am to 5 pm. Messages sent after 5 pm get a reply the next day, unless it's urgent.
Yes, I come to your getting-ready location. Travel costs depend on the location and are listed in the quote.

items.q: What time do you arrive on the wedding day?
items.a: We set it based on the photo schedule and the number of people to style. I usually arrive a few hours before photos, so nothing feels rushed.
It's not required, but it lets you choose a style calmly and see how it holds. We'll talk about it when I reply.

items.q: How many people can you style on one morning?
items.a: It depends on the timing and the styles. Tell me how many people and I'll build a schedule that works.

items.q: How do I book the date?
items.a: Once I confirm the date is free, it's held with a deposit. I'll send the details with your quote.

booking.title: Tell me about your event
booking.text: A few short details, and they reach me neatly on WhatsApp. I'll come back with availability and a quote.

bridal.title: Bridal hair
bridal.intro: Bridal hair has to look right in the first photo and at the last dance. I build it around your dress, your veil and your face, and I come to wherever you're getting ready.

styles.x: Low and sleek, soft and undone, or high and dramatic. Ideal with an open back and a long veil.
Face open, length down. Add a pin, flowers or a bow.
Soft or Hollywood, glossy and full, and still there at the end of the night.
Tiara, pearl pins or flowers, secured so they stay put, even on the dance floor.

evening.title: Evening hair
evening.intro: For the mother of the bride, sisters, friends or your own event. A hairstyle that suits the dress and the night, and stays in place while you dance.

styles.x: Glossy and full, long or shoulder-length.
Elegant and neat, for a high neckline or an open back.
A sleek high ponytail or a soft braid for a younger crowd.

evening.companionsText: Styling several people on one morning is all about timing. Tell me how many of you there are and when you need to be ready, and I'll build a clear plan.

masterclass.intro: Private training at your own pace, on a real model, with everything I've learned on wedding mornings.
